artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: New module, source only; nothing deploys (the release is OG-r-1's, the ALB OG-i-3's). GET /schwab/download/login mints a random state and nonce, seals them with the return path in a transaction cookie and redirects to the upstream for OpenID scopes only, with this callback as the redirect URI. GET /schwab/download/callback refuses unless the state equals the transaction cookie's (before any code exchange), redeems the code for this callback's redirect URI, validates the ID token with OG-a-2's token_broker.verify_upstream_id_token against the transaction's nonce, applies the kill switch and blocklist, and sets the session cookie. Cookies: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, host-only, Path=/schwab/download, Fernet tokens under a key derived from FERNET_KEY for this use only. read_session / session_principal give the download routes the principal, re-checked against the authorized tenants and principal revocation. No import of identity.py. commit-gate: 'OK: pre-commit gate clean for 3 of 3 file(s)'.
